name: Lacuna
description: A Vantablack Media tentpole in which you inhabit the consciousness of a Spire architect who discovers the structural plans beneath GLMZ are designed to let the Shelf flood during the 2190 lake surge — and are rewarded for burying the evidence. The neural-feed forces you to feel the protagonist's rationalizations as your own, blurring complicity and entertainment in ways critics called 'the most uncomfortable three hours in feed history.' Grossed over Φ4.2 billion in its opening cycle.
cultural_impact: Introduced the term 'lacuna logic' into GLMZ slang — meaning the deliberate mental gap people maintain to avoid confronting their complicity in systemic harm.
story_hooks: A runner acquires a bootleg feed chip containing an alternate cut of Lacuna that includes 40 minutes of excised footage naming real Spire families involved in the flood decision.
A Vantablack executive hires the players to locate the director, Saoirse Okafor-Lindqvist, who has gone dark after publicly stating the film was 'closer to documentary than fiction.'
Someone is selling neural-feed sessions that claim to be the raw, unedited experience logs from the film's production — and the sensations are deeply wrong in ways that suggest they aren't fiction.
